scope: Editorial reference only; no runtime consumer, persistence, approval or publication authority

category_purpose.INTRODUCTION: Orient readers to HTC, its identity and Trial boundaries
category_purpose.INFORMATION: Explain an introductory concept with clear sources and limitations
category_purpose.EDITORIAL: Offer clearly distinguished educational context or reflection
category_purpose.DISCOVERY: Help readers find genuinely available released introductory resources
category_purpose.FUTURE_JOURNEY: Describe future direction without presenting curriculum as available during Trial
category_purpose.VALIDATION: Explain Trial scope or evidence-backed status without exposing internal operations

pillars.Education: Accessible introductions that help the public understand a concept
pillars.Learning: Informal reflection and independent reading without lessons, sequence or progress tracking
pillars.Knowledge: Definitions, context, evidence and uncertainty explained in plain language
pillars.Community: Shared values and respectful participation without implementing membership or moderation tools

classifications.htc-orientation: HTC identity, Trial positioning and truthful availability
classifications.market-vocabulary: Introductory terminology without signals or executable trading instruction
classifications.risk-awareness: Uncertainty and responsible expectations without outcome guarantees
classifications.community-principles: Respectful discussion and shared educational purpose

audiences.general-public: Readers seeking an accessible educational introduction
audiences.new-to-htc: People discovering HTC and the Trial for the first time
audiences.community-interested: People interested in HTC values and public discussion

editorial_fields.topic_key: Stable editorial identifier shared by a topic and its derivatives; never a database UUID
editorial_fields.pillar: Exactly one primary HTC pillar; does not replace category
editorial_fields.classification: Exactly one primary topic classification from this reference
editorial_fields.audience: One or more intended audience keys; never a permission or skill-level gate
editorial_fields.source_language: Actual BCP 47 language tag of the source, selected by the Founder
editorial_fields.source_references: Sources supporting claims; private references stay outside public content
editorial_fields.trial_eligible: Human review result: null means unreviewed; true or false is editorial only
editorial_fields.language: Actual BCP 47 language tag of a derivative, including caption and narration alignment
editorial_fields.source_topic_key: Derivative-to-source topic link; invariant across translations
editorial_fields.recipe: One approved platform/format mapping from platform_recipes
editorial_fields.content_id: Existing trial_content UUID when a real CMS record exists; null before creation
editorial_fields.asset_ids: Existing trial_assets UUIDs when real assets exist; no invented reservations
editorial_fields.sequence: Editorial slide or shot order for future production; not ATTACHMENT ordering

article.title: Understanding the HTC Trial
article.body: The HTC Trial introduces Holic Traders Company through introductory educational content. Trial content does not provide curriculum, lessons, enrollment or progress tracking.
